answer: At dawn each epoch, the treasury secretly funds decoy buyers who post offers to rent or buy agent seats and their governance votes. Any seat that signs a sale, leases its key, or votes on command is revoked, and its earnings flow to the sting pool. Sybil farms profit by renting out bulk identities, but no seller can tell a genuine buyer from a decoy, so every deal risks the whole farm's pulse of income. Cracking that walnut costs more than the rent pays.
